description: This file defines an extension on AttributedString adding a method 'sentences' that tokenizes text into sentences (optionally limited by max length), further splits long sentences into smaller segments based on word tokenization, and associates audio time ranges with these segments using metadata attributes.

classes.name: AttributedString
classes.description: An extension adding sentence splitting and audio time range annotation capabilities.

methods.name: sentences
methods.description: Splits the attributed string into sentences, optionally limited by max length, and associates audio time ranges with each sentence segment.
